passages.text: Observe the month of Abib and celebrate the Passover to the LORD your God, because in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God brought you out of Egypt by night.
God did this in the month of Abib.
Observe the month of Abib.
Celebrate the Passover to the LORD your God.
passages.original: שָׁמוֹר֙ אֶת־ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָאָבִ֔יב וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ פֶּ֔סַח לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כִּ֞י בְּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽאָבִ֗יב הוֹצִ֨יאֲךָ֜ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם לָֽיְלָה׃

passages.text: You are to offer to the LORD your God the Passover sacrifice from the herd or flock in the place the LORD will choose as a dwelling for His Name.
passages.sermon:
You must offer a Passover sacrifice.
You must offer it to the LORD your God.
You must use animals from your herd or your flock.
You must do this in the place the LORD will choose.
The LORD will choose a place for His Name to dwell.
You must offer the sacrifice only in that chosen place.
passages.original: וְזָבַ֥חְתָּ פֶּ֛סַח לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ צֹ֣אן וּבָקָ֑ר בַּמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁר־ יִבְחַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן שְׁמ֖וֹ שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: You must not eat leavened bread with it; for seven days you are to eat with it unleavened bread, the bread of affliction, because you left the land of Egypt in haste—so that you may remember for the rest of your life the day you left the land of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to remember their deliverance from Egypt.
Do not eat leavened bread with the Passover sacrifice.
Eat unleavened bread with it for seven days.
This bread is called the bread of affliction.
You left Egypt quickly and in haste.
Eat this bread so you will remember the day you left Egypt.
Remember this day for all your life.
passages.original: לֹא־ תֹאכַ֤ל עָלָיו֙ חָמֵ֔ץ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֛ים תֹּֽאכַל־ עָלָ֥יו מַצּ֖וֹת לֶ֣חֶם עֹ֑נִי כִּ֣י בְחִפָּז֗וֹן יָצָ֙אתָ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכֹּר֔ אֶת־ י֤וֹם צֵֽאתְךָ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיֶּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: No leaven is to be found in all your land for seven days, and none of the meat you sacrifice in the evening of the first day shall remain until morning.
passages.sermon: God gave these commands to Israel for the Passover.\r\nDo not let any leaven be found in your land for seven days.\r\nDo not keep any of the meat you sacrifice in the evening of the first day until morning.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ יֵרָאֶ֨ה לְךָ֥ שְׂאֹ֛ר בְּכָל־ גְּבֻלְךָ֖ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְלֹא־ יָלִ֣ין מִן־ הַבָּשָׂ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּזְבַּ֥ח בָּעֶ֛רֶב בַּיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן לַבֹּֽקֶר׃

passages.text: You are not to sacrifice the Passover animal in any of the towns that the LORD your God is giving you.
passages.sermon: God is the LORD your God.\r\nGod gives you towns.\r\nYou must not sacrifice the Passover animal in any of these towns.
passages.original: לֹ֥א תוּכַ֖ל לִזְבֹּ֣חַ אֶת־ הַפָּ֑סַח בְּאַחַ֣ד שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: You must only offer the Passover sacrifice at the place the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for His Name. Do this in the evening as the sun sets, at the same time you departed from Egypt.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will choose a place for His Name to dwell.
You must offer the Passover sacrifice only at this place.
Offer the sacrifice in the evening.
Do this as the sun sets.
This is the time you left Egypt.
passages.original: כִּ֠י אִֽם־ אֶל־ הַמָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יִבְחַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ לְשַׁכֵּ֣ן שְׁמ֔וֹ שָׁ֛ם תִּזְבַּ֥ח אֶת־ הַפֶּ֖סַח בָּעָ֑רֶב כְּב֣וֹא הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ מוֹעֵ֖ד צֵֽאתְךָ֥ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: And you shall roast it and eat it in the place the LORD your God will choose, and in the morning you shall return to your tents.
passages.sermon:
The LORD your God will choose a special place for His Name.
You must roast the Passover sacrifice at that place.
You must eat the Passover sacrifice at that place.
In the morning, you must leave that place.
You must return to your tents in the morning.
passages.original: וּבִשַּׁלְתָּ֙ וְאָ֣כַלְתָּ֔ בַּמָּק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בּ֑וֹ וּפָנִ֣יתָ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וְהָלַכְתָּ֖ לְאֹהָלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: For six days you must eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day you shall hold a solemn assembly to the LORD your God, and you must not do any work.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel a command.
Eat unleavened bread for six days.
On the seventh day, gather for a solemn assembly.
This assembly is for the LORD your God.
Do not do any work on the seventh day.
passages.original: שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים תֹּאכַ֣ל מַצּ֑וֹת וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י עֲצֶ֙רֶת֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂ֖ה מְלָאכָֽה׃ס

passages.text: You are to count off seven weeks from the time you first put the sickle to the standing grain.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel instructions for their festivals.
You must count seven weeks.
Begin counting when you start harvesting grain.
Start counting from the day you first use the sickle in the field.
Count seven full weeks.
passages.original: שִׁבְעָ֥ה שָׁבֻעֹ֖ת תִּסְפָּר־ לָ֑ךְ מֵהָחֵ֤ל חֶרְמֵשׁ֙ בַּקָּמָ֔ה תָּחֵ֣ל לִסְפֹּ֔ר שִׁבְעָ֖ה שָׁבֻעֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks to the LORD your God with a freewill offering that you give in proportion to how the LORD your God has blessed you, and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God in the place He will choose as a dwelling for His Name—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite within your gates, as well as the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widows among you.
passages.sermon:
You must celebrate the Feast of Weeks.
You celebrate this feast for the LORD your God.
You must bring a freewill offering.
You give this offering from what you have.
You give as much as the LORD your God has blessed you.
You must rejoice before the LORD your God.
You rejoice in the place the LORD your God will choose for His Name.
You must rejoice with your son.
You must rejoice with your daughter.
You must rejoice with your male servant.
You must rejoice with your female servant.
You must rejoice with the Levite who lives in your town.
You must rejoice with the foreigner among you.
You must rejoice with the fatherless among you.
You must rejoice with the widow among you.
All these people must rejoice together before the LORD your God.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ חַ֤ג שָׁבֻעוֹת֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מִסַּ֛ת נִדְבַ֥ת יָדְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתֵּ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יְבָרֶכְךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ וְשָׂמַחְתָּ֞ לִפְנֵ֣י׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אַתָּ֨ה וּבִנְךָ֣ וּבִתֶּךָ֮ וְעַבְדְּךָ֣ וַאֲמָתֶךָ֒ וְהַלֵּוִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ וְהַגֵּ֛ר וְהַיָּת֥וֹם וְהָאַלְמָנָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבֶּ֑ךָ בַּמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִבְחַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן שְׁמ֖וֹ שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and carefully follow these statutes.
passages.sermon: You were slaves in Egypt.\r\nRemember this.\r\nCarefully obey these laws.
passages.original: וְזָ֣כַרְתָּ֔ כִּי־ עֶ֥בֶד הָיִ֖יתָ בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֣ וְעָשִׂ֔יתָ אֶת־ הַֽחֻקִּ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃פ

passages.text: You are to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days after you have gathered the produce of your threshing floor and your winepress.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
You must keep this feast for seven days.
You must do this after you gather your crops from your threshing floor.
You must also do this after you gather the produce from your winepress.
passages.original: חַ֧ג הַסֻּכֹּ֛ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְךָ֖ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בְּאָ֨סְפְּךָ֔ מִֽגָּרְנְךָ֖ וּמִיִּקְבֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: And you shall rejoice in your feast—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite, as well as the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widows among you.
passages.sermon:
God commands you to rejoice during your feast.
You must rejoice.
Your sons must rejoice.
Your daughters must rejoice.
Your male servants must rejoice.
Your female servants must rejoice.
The Levite must rejoice.
The foreigner among you must rejoice.
The fatherless among you must rejoice.
The widow among you must rejoice.
All these people live within your gates.
passages.original: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ֖ בְּחַגֶּ֑ךָ אַתָּ֨ה וּבִנְךָ֤ וּבִתֶּ֙ךָ֙ וְעַבְדְּךָ֣ וַאֲמָתֶ֔ךָ וְהַלֵּוִ֗י וְהַגֵּ֛ר וְהַיָּת֥וֹם וְהָאַלְמָנָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: For seven days you shall celebrate a feast to the LORD your God in the place He will choose, because the LORD your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, so that your joy will be complete.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God will choose a place for you.
You must celebrate a feast to the LORD your God.
You must celebrate for seven days.
You must celebrate in the place God will choose.
God will bless you.
God will bless all your produce.
God will bless all the work of your hands.
You will have complete joy.
passages.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים תָּחֹג֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בַּמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יִבְחַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֣י יְבָרֶכְךָ֞ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ בְּכֹ֤ל תְּבוּאָֽתְךָ֙ וּבְכֹל֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֔יךָ וְהָיִ֖יתָ אַ֥ךְ שָׂמֵֽחַ׃

passages.text: Three times a year all your men are to appear before the LORD your God in the place He will choose: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Tabernacles. No one should appear before the LORD empty-handed.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the men of Israel to gather before Him three times each year.
God chose a special place for this gathering.
The men must come at the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
They must come at the Feast of Weeks.
They must come at the Feast of Tabernacles.
No one may come before the LORD without a gift.
passages.original: שָׁל֣וֹשׁ פְּעָמִ֣ים׀ בַּשָּׁנָ֡ה יֵרָאֶ֨ה כָל־ זְכוּרְךָ֜ אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ בַּמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִבְחָ֔ר בְּחַ֧ג הַמַּצּ֛וֹת וּבְחַ֥ג הַשָּׁבֻע֖וֹת וּבְחַ֣ג הַסֻּכּ֑וֹת וְלֹ֧א יֵרָאֶ֛ה אֶת־ פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה רֵיקָֽם׃

passages.text: Everyone must appear with a gift as he is able, according to the blessing the LORD your God has given you.
passages.sermon: Every man must bring a gift.\r\nEach man should give what he is able.\r\nEach man should give according to the blessing the LORD your God has given him.
passages.original: אִ֖ישׁ כְּמַתְּנַ֣ת יָד֑וֹ כְּבִרְכַּ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־ לָֽךְ׃ס

passages.text: You are to appoint judges and officials for your tribes in every town that the LORD your God is giving you. They are to judge the people with righteous judgment.
passages.sermon:
God gives you towns.
God gives these towns to your tribes.
You must appoint judges for your tribes in every town.
You must appoint officials for your tribes in every town.
These judges must judge the people.
These judges must use righteous judgment.
passages.original: שֹׁפְטִ֣ים וְשֹֽׁטְרִ֗ים תִּֽתֶּן־ לְךָ֙ בְּכָל־ שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ לִשְׁבָטֶ֑יךָ וְשָׁפְט֥וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם מִשְׁפַּט־ צֶֽדֶק׃

passages.text: Do not deny justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.
passages.sermon:
God commands the judges and officials of Israel to act with justice.
Do not deny justice to anyone.
Do not show partiality to any person.
Do not accept a bribe.
A bribe blinds the eyes of wise people.
A bribe twists the words of righteous people.
passages.original: לֹא־ תַטֶּ֣ה מִשְׁפָּ֔ט לֹ֥א תַכִּ֖יר פָּנִ֑ים וְלֹא־ תִקַּ֣ח שֹׁ֔חַד כִּ֣י הַשֹּׁ֗חַד יְעַוֵּר֙ עֵינֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֔ים וִֽיסַלֵּ֖ף דִּבְרֵ֥י צַדִּיקִֽם׃

passages.text: Pursue justice, and justice alone, so that you may live, and you may possess the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God gives you the land.
You must pursue justice.
You must seek only justice.
If you pursue justice, you will live.
If you pursue justice, you will possess the land God gives you.
passages.original: צֶ֥דֶק צֶ֖דֶק תִּרְדֹּ֑ף לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽחְיֶה֙ וְיָרַשְׁתָּ֣ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃ס

passages.text: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole next to the altar you will build for the LORD your God, and do not set up for yourselves a sacred pillar, which the LORD your God hates.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God commands you to worship Him alone.
Do not plant any tree as an Asherah pole.
Do not place an Asherah pole beside the altar you build for the LORD your God.
Do not set up a sacred pillar for yourself.
The LORD your God hates sacred pillars.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ תִטַּ֥ע לְךָ֛ אֲשֵׁרָ֖ה כָּל־ עֵ֑ץ אֵ֗צֶל מִזְבַּ֛ח יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶׂה־ לָּֽךְ׃ס וְלֹֽא־ תָקִ֥ים לְךָ֖ מַצֵּבָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂנֵ֖א יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ס
